$comment: p15-oracle-073: the palette and paletteKey action families (the 81 ids of plans/cmux-next/action-surfaces.json whose family prefix is palette or paletteKey and that scripts/cmux-next/every-action-gaps.json does not exclude). scripts/cmux-next/oracle/gen_actions.py (p15-oracle-071) reads this file (load_tuning) and writes one case per action into the flat actions suite. Each entry was reviewed against its handler in Packages/macOS/CmuxNext/Sources/CmuxNextApp: receipt is the ActionEffect kind (legacy bind/run handlers report action.done), error the typed refusal a script caller gets (an action.run refusal is control.unavailable), before the setup a success path needs, waitFor the facet the action changes. A `note` that starts with `divergence <key>` files a finding against Chrome's design or the budget contract for routing; the case stays green because the oracle is differential. Destructive ids and the paletteKey ids stay blocked by the sweep's flags; their tuning keeps the checks for when the flag lifts.
